pages.en:
No
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE (DETECTIVE BRANCH)）
C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No 1005
Shanghai Municipal Council
March 14th 1917.

Sir,

A report has been made to the effect that
a man named Dittman who stays at the Astor
House spends a good deal of his time at a window
from which he can see the German Consulate.
He has conversations with Nielsen after which
the latter leaves him and goes over to the
German Consulate.

Your Obedient Servant,
mmmuuuummstung
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

ASH
14/3/17.
pages.zh:
编号
（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处（侦探股））
刑事侦缉处
情报官登记册
第 1005 号

上海公共租界工部局
1917年3月14日

先生：

据报告称，一名名为迪特曼（Dittman）的男子，现寓居礼查饭店（Astor House），常长时间驻足于一扇窗户旁，从该处可眺望德国领事馆。他与尼尔森（Nielsen）交谈后，后者便离开他，前往德国领事馆。

您忠实的仆人，
mmmuuuummstung
首席探长

警察总监上尉

ASH
1917年3月14日
